keycast.title: Show shortcuts on screen
keycast.description: Record the keys you press as a key-cap badge on the video, so a lesson can teach the shortcut itself. It is off by default and stays on your machine.
keycast.enableHint: Turn it on in Settings → Cursor.
keycast.positionHint: Position, size, opacity and how long the badge stays visible are all in Settings → Cursor.

systemWide.screenshotDescription: System-wide capture shortcut: it works even when Recordly is not focused. Set or change it in Settings → Screenshots.
